changelog:
- Initial release of mailparser skill.
- Extracts structured data (company, email, contact person, discount code, type) from plain text email content.
- Outputs concise JSON with all extracted fields.
- Email type classified as order, offer, newsletter, or other.
- Identifies company from domain and extracts discount codes when available.
summary: Extract structured data from email text, identifying company domain, contact, discount codes, and classifying email type as order, offer, newsletter, or other.
